meta.purpose: Selected FloodNet events for the PLUVIA replay prototype. These are the events the demo replays; the candidate pool they were drawn from is in data/nyc/raw/floodnet_events_2026_0101plus.json (25-row >=5in pool, September 2026).
selection_criteria: tidally_influenced = No (verified per sensor against kb2e-tjy3 on 2026-10-10) so the replay shows rainfall-driven, not tide-driven, street flooding
event has a published flood_profile_depth_inches and flood_profile_time_secs with length parity (verified, see qc/floodnet_qc_log_2026-10-10.json)
event is QC-plausible: onset <= duration sanity held; the single citywide onset-outlier row (BK Hoyt St 2023-09-29) is excluded and recorded in the QC log
sensor has stable 2026 history (no gap-fabrication: sensors missing data on a day are NOT counted as dry)
meta.non_claim: These three events do not by themselves establish general citywide risk. They are point measurements at three specific non-tidal locations during one rain event (2026-09-26). Demo narration must say 'what three sensors recorded', never 'what NYC experiences'.
meta.evidence_label_rule: measured = published sensor measurement; forecast = model input from Open-Meteo; reported = 311 complaint; inferred = PLUVIA computation over the above; unavailable = explicitly missing. Missing is never coerced to zero or 'no flooding'.

selected.profile: data/nyc/raw/floodnet_replay_profiles_2026-10-10.json rows[0] (288 depth / 288 time points, parity verified)
selected.why: Deepest 2026 event in the pool window; long rise and drain; installed 2026-04-03 so multi-month record incl. two more >=5in events (2026-09-27 15.0in, 2026-09-28 5.51in) that let the demo show repeat-stress at one corner.
selected.history_note: Sensor record starts 2026-04-03; absence before that is 'unavailable', not 'never floods'.

selected.history_note: CAUTION: installed 2026-07-30, so ~2 months of record at snapshot time. Demo must not describe this location as 'rarely floods'.
